items.name: SPIN PREVENTION /SPIN RECOVERY
execution: SP executes entry in spin, followed by Spin Prevention or Spin Recovery Procedures.
conditions: Upon Spin Prevention/Recovery execution, the following conditions apply:
1/ Day only (VFR – VMC).
2/ The technique and restrictions determined in the Techniques and Procedures Manual are used.

general_criteria.text: Knows the recovery procedures by heart.
During recovery, makes smooth and solid stick movements.
Recovers the A/C with minimum loss of altitude.
Does not allow the appearance of secondary stall. In such a case SP takes the proper action.
Does not exceed the A/C limits.

flags: Δεν υπάρχει ενότητα '2/ SPECIFIC CRITERIA' για το item (10) - το (c) EXPECTED PERFORMANCE περιέχει μόνο GENERAL CRITERIA (σελ. 33).

items.name: UNUSUAL ATTITUDES RECOVERY
execution: SP executes recovery from the following unusual attitudes:
1/ Nose-high recovery.
2/ Nose-low recovery.
3/ Inverted recovery.
conditions: Upon the Training Exercise execution, the following restrictions apply:
1/ IP sets the A/C attitude.
2/ Minimum pitch up is 45ο.
3/ Minimum pitch down is 30ο.
4/ All possible banks are to be expected.
5/ Day only (VFR – VMC).
6/ Within the assigned flight area.
7/ At the altitude determined in the Techniques and Procedures Manual and the SOPs.

general_criteria.text: Rolls the A/C to level off towards the nearest direction.
Does not allow the appearance of stall or performs Split «S».
Executes recovery with minimum loss of altitude, without exceeding the A/C limits.

3/ Aileron Roll
4/ Barrel Roll

Controls the A/C in a smooth and solid way, without allowing it to enter a stall.
Uses outside visual cues / reference lines in order to perform the maneuvers.

Knows the entry points and the approach procedures.
When required, uses VOR and GPS to orient in space and return to the airport.

items.name: LANDING PATTERN (NORMAL, NO FLAP, FLAP T/O - AΟA)
items.heading_verbatim: (23),(25),(27),(32) LANDING PATTERN (NORMAL, NO FLAP, FLAP T/O - AΟA)
execution: SP performs an overhead landing pattern (Break - Downwind - Base Leg – Final until the runway threshold) taking into consideration prevailing wind conditions and performs according to the A/C manual and the Techniques and Procedures manual.
conditions: Day or Night.

general_criteria.text: Executes Break within the break zone, with ATC clearance and after clearing the downwind.
Places the A/C in downwind with minimum airspeed of 120 KIAS. In case of an AOA pattern, reduces the airspeed accordingly.
Adheres to the limitations of the A/C regarding the landing gear and the flaps.
Performs the required checks.
Gives the standardized reports.
Does not deviate or converge from the final.
Is aligned with the RWY centerline up to ½ NM prior to the RWY threshold.
Does not exceed 45o of bank on base leg and plans the final as described in the Techniques and Procedures Manual (Roll Out Point).
If required for any reason to execute a go around, he/she executes it in time and correctly, without any hesitation.
Does not allow the onset of stall characteristics.

Performs the maneuver according to the Techniques and Procedures Manual and adheres to the limitations of the A/C regarding the landing gear and the flaps.
Performs the required checks.
Gives the standardized reports.
If required for any reason to execute a go around, he/she executes it in time and correctly, without any hesitation.

items.name: EMERGENCY LANDING PATTERN (ELP)
execution: SP executes ELP, following IP’s command and according to Techniques and Procedures Manual.
conditions: In the execution of ELP, the following conditions apply:
1/ Execution after IP’s command and ATC clearance.
2/ SP reacts to a hypothetically emergency situation.
3/ Day only (VFR / VMC).

general_criteria.text: Plans ELP in order to touch within the first 1/3 of the RWY.
Configures the A/C timely and correctly.
Is cognizant of the engine restart procedure and executes it in simulation.
Does not allow the appearance of stall characteristics, which may lead to advancing the throttle.
ELP will only be flown for touch and go or Go Around.

items.name: LANDING (FLAPS LDG - FLAPS UP - FLAPS Τ/Ο - ELP - AΟA)
items.heading_verbatim: (24),(26),(28),(33) LANDING (FLAPS LDG - FLAPS UP - FLAPS Τ/Ο - ELP - AΟA)
execution: 1/ Landing is considered the phase between the beginning of the level off (round out to flare), up to the point where either the engine acceleration begins (Touch and Go) or the A/C vacates the RWY (Full stop).
2/ Starts gradual reduction to power and reduce the rate of descent in order to level-off the A/C and assume landing attitude.
3/ Brings the A/C to touchdown point, with the proper attitude.
4/ After touchdown, either decelerates the A/C until safe taxi speed and vacates the RWY (Full stop) or advances the throttle to take off (Touch and Go).
conditions: Day or night.

general_criteria.text: Directs A/C to the RWY centerline.
Executes timely the round out procedure in order to level off the A/C and assume landing attitude.
SP brings the A/C in touch with the RWY, as described in Flight Manuals.
After touchdown, decelerates to taxi speed by applying the standard procedure. During deceleration, SP avoids abrupt oscillations and vacates the RWY following the LAPs, without any deviations.
Prevents and /or recognizes the appearance of high flare, late and rapid Roundout, Porpoising, Floating, Ballooning, Bouncing or touch down the RWY with a Drift and reacts accordingly.
Applies proper crosswind controls. In case not proper crosswind controls are applied and the student is not within proper touchdown parameters, he/she executes a go-around.
Executes touchdown within the first 1/3 of runway length, in an ELP.

items.name: GO AROUND
execution: When SP performs Go Around, he/she executes a pre-planned Go Around, with his/her own initiative, or following command by IP, ATC or the Contact Car Officer.
conditions: In the execution of Go Around, the following conditions apply:
1/ Day or Night.
2/ Go Around is executed either when landing is not ensured or is performed as a pre-planned maneuver.

general_criteria.text: Makes the right decision to Go Around in a timely manner, when required.
Responds immediately and executes Go Around without any delay, as soon as the order is given by IP or ATC or the Contact Car Officer.
Cleans the A/C configuration according to standard procedures and within the airspeed limitations.
Follows the standard procedure according to the Techniques and Procedures Manual.
Does not allow the onset of stall characteristics.
Does not violate the landing pattern altitude as reported in LAP.
